verify.cmd:
u=$(oc get node crc -o jsonpath='{.spec.unschedulable}') || exit 1
test "$u" != true

for i in $(seq 1 24); do
  pending=$(oc get pods -A --field-selector=status.phase=Pending --no-headers -o custom-columns=NS:.metadata.namespace) || exit 1
  grep -q '^openshift-' <<<"$pending" || exit 0
  sleep 5
done
oc get pods -A --field-selector=status.phase=Pending
exit 1
